name: FAMOUS CHOLLIMA technology-sector hands-on-keyboard aggregate

attribution.legal_posture: Source-attributed aggregate or sector-targeting telemetry; affected-organization finding, adjudication, successful employment, and compromise remain unreported.

caveats: The 47% metric applies only to CrowdStrike’s technology-sector, state-sponsored, hands-on-keyboard denominator.
The metric reports 47% within its stated scope; all-attacks, state-sponsored, technology-incident, and DPRK-activity totals require separate denominators.

statements: CrowdStrike reports that FAMOUS CHOLLIMA accounted for 47% of all state-sponsored hands-on-keyboard operations against the technology sector.
CrowdStrike reports employment-seeking activity against technology companies in North America, Europe, and Asia.
limitations: The 47% metric applies only to CrowdStrike’s technology-sector, state-sponsored, hands-on-keyboard denominator.
The metric does not mean 47% of all attacks, all state-sponsored attacks, all technology incidents, or all DPRK activity.

sources.support: CrowdStrike reports that FAMOUS CHOLLIMA represented 47% of all state-sponsored hands-on-keyboard operations against the technology sector, and that its employment-seeking activity targeted technology companies across North America, Europe, and Asia. Evidence boundary: Aggregate vendor telemetry with a narrow denominator. The 47% figure is not a percentage of all attacks, all technology-sector incidents, all nation-state activity, or all DPRK operations. The related CrowdStrike report landing page already appears in raw research; the blog supplies the direct claim text and is not independent corroboration of that report
